title: ALTO simulator numeric helper accepts NaN as a passing comparison
summary: The new local number_is helper uses fabs(actual-expected)>tolerance, so a cached NaN passes. Exact unchanged-function synthetic proof returns true; environment/property/preset assertions use it. Reject nonfinite unexpected values/tolerance and use the shared corrected assertion contract. New custom helper scope is distinct from closed common ASSERT_NEAR findingbc8d-029. Next action: coordinator assigns a focused repair and relevant regression.
